$comment: Pinned model/provider configuration for the PyJWT bounded-task rule-generation pilot (Arms C/D). Amended to Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier to enforce the zero-monetary-cost constraint prior to observing any pilot generation. Consumed by console/panels/llmAttempts.js and console/panels/costUsage.js.
status: configured, not yet executed -- blocked on GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable (see protocol.md §12)
amendment_note: Amended 2026-09-10 from claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 to gemini-3.7-flash to enforce zero monetary cost. No model output had been observed prior to this amendment.
scope: PyJWT 1->2 bounded task only. SQLAlchemy and Pydantic pilot generation configs are not decided by this pass.
api: Google Generative Language API (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.7-flash:generateContent), x-goog-api-key authentication
model_id_pinning_note: Google Gemini Developer API model 'gemini-3.7-flash'. Accessible under the Google AI Studio Free Tier with zero monetary spend required.
why_this_model: Zero monetary cost on Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier, satisfying the hard project constraint of zero required spend.
State-of-the-art fast reasoning model with native JSON output support (responseMimeType: application/json).
Reports detailed usageMetadata (promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, totalTokenCount, and thoughtsTokenCount where thinking tokens are exposed) directly on every response.
Zero paid billing, credit card, or organization contract required to execute reproducible pilot runs.
Rate limits under Free Tier (15 RPM, 1,000,000 TPM, 1,500 RPD) comfortably accommodate the PyJWT pilot's bounded requests.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Requires paid billing and a funded API account; rejected under the zero-monetary-cost constraint.
Requires paid API credits or billing setup; rejected under the zero-cost constraint.

request_parameters.temperature_caveat: Temperature 0 reduces variance but does not guarantee bit-identical hosted output across distributed inferences.
request_parameters.max_output_tokens_rationale: Sufficient buffer for the ~200-500 token rule bundle output while bounding generation length.

caching_policy.caching_status: Not enabled on Free Tier; prompt is sent per request within Free Tier quotas without cost penalty.

price_schedule.tier: Google Gemini Developer API Free Tier
price_schedule.note: Free Tier access. Zero billed dollars.

generation_replicates_rationale: 2 replicates to distinguish single-shot fluke from repeatable generation behavior.
repair_trajectory_policy: paired-prefix: one generation replicate = one trajectory of up to 5 sequential requests sharing the evidence-packet context; budgets 1/2/3/5 are read off prefixes of that trajectory.

retry_and_timeout_policy.policy_note: A request exceeding the timeout or retry cap is logged as an infrastructure failure, not retried indefinitely.
retry_and_timeout_policy.semantic_vs_transport: A malformed/invalid JSON response counts as a used proposal in the repair sweep, never as a free transport retry.
